scope: Curated directory of public AI accelerator benchmark suites, result portals and measurement tools. This catalogue records publicly available information; it does not run benchmarks or claim that a listed tool supports every accelerator.

projects.name: MLPerf
projects.description: A family of standardized AI system benchmarks spanning training, inference, client/mobile, Tiny, HPC and power. Results are submitted under suite-specific rules.
projects.comparability: Compare only within the same suite version, scenario, division, accuracy target and system boundary.

projects.name: SemiAnalysis InferenceX / AgentX
projects.description: Public benchmark and analysis of real inference systems, including interactive LLM serving and agentic workloads where published.
projects.comparability: Pin model, recipe, hardware, software stack, precision, parallelism, input/output lengths, concurrency and SLO. Keep AgentX separate from fixed-prompt decode.

projects.name: GenAI-Perf / Perf Analyzer
projects.description: Client-side tools for generating inference traffic and measuring request-level and token-level latency and throughput.
projects.comparability: A measurement tool, not a neutral leaderboard. Client version, request distribution, load model and server configuration affect results.

projects.name: vLLM benchmark tools
projects.description: Benchmark scripts and serving workloads used to evaluate vLLM throughput, latency and scheduling behavior.
projects.comparability: Pin vLLM release/commit, model revision, hardware, backend, quantization, request distribution and benchmark command.

projects.name: SGLang benchmark tools
projects.description: Benchmark tooling and recipes for evaluating SGLang serving performance and runtime features.
projects.comparability: Record exact SGLang version, model, attention backend, scheduler, cache policy, workload and hardware.

projects.name: llmperf
projects.description: Open-source load testing and performance measurement for LLM APIs and serving endpoints.
projects.comparability: Results depend on client load generation, request distribution, endpoint behavior and server configuration.

projects.name: KernelBench
projects.description: Evaluates correctness and performance of AI-generated GPU kernels against reference implementations.
projects.comparability: Pin task set, evaluator, timeout, compilation policy, correctness tolerance and target hardware.

projects.name: KernelBench-Verified
projects.description: Verification-oriented GPU kernel generation benchmark designed to strengthen correctness and evaluation confidence.
projects.comparability: Do not merge results with original KernelBench without a task/evaluator mapping.

projects.name: KernelBenchX
projects.description: Expanded GPU kernel benchmark with a different task mix and evaluation scope from the original KernelBench.
projects.comparability: Treat as a separate benchmark. Inspect current paper, task set and evaluator before comparing.

projects.name: TritonBench
projects.description: Operator-level benchmark suite for Triton and related kernel implementations, with multiple submodules and backends.
projects.comparability: Pin submodule revisions, PyTorch, Triton, compiler, backend, shapes, dtypes and hardware.

projects.name: FlagGems
projects.description: Multi-backend Triton operator library with benchmark scripts and accelerator backend integrations.
projects.comparability: An operator library and its tests, not a neutral cross-vendor leaderboard. Backend maturity and coverage vary.

projects.name: FlashInfer benchmarks
projects.description: Kernel and operator benchmarks for LLM inference primitives including attention, KV cache, GEMM and MoE.
projects.comparability: Pin GPU, CUDA/ROCm, compiler, kernel version, tensor shapes, sequence lengths and precision.

projects.name: CUTLASS Profiler
projects.description: Profiling and benchmarking utilities for NVIDIA GEMM, convolution and related GPU kernels.
projects.comparability: NVIDIA-specific tooling. Compare only matched operation, shape, precision and measurement settings.

projects.name: Composable Kernel
projects.description: AMD GPU kernel programming and performance infrastructure, including examples and benchmark paths.
projects.comparability: AMD/ROCm-specific. Pin ROCm version, target architecture, kernel revision, shapes and precision.

projects.name: STREAM
projects.description: Measures sustainable memory bandwidth using standard vector kernels.
projects.comparability: Record CPU/GPU implementation, NUMA placement, thread count, data size and compiler options.

projects.name: CUDA bandwidthTest
projects.description: Measures host-to-device, device-to-host and device-to-device transfer bandwidth.
projects.comparability: CUDA-specific. Record transfer size, pinned/pageable memory, topology, peer access and software versions.

projects.name: NCCL Tests
projects.description: Collective communication benchmarks for NCCL operations across GPUs and nodes.
projects.comparability: Record ranks, message size, topology, algorithm, transport, concurrency and intra-/inter-node boundary.

projects.name: RCCL
projects.description: ROCm collective communication library and associated test infrastructure for AMD GPUs.
projects.comparability: AMD-specific. Match operation, rank count, message size, topology and software versions.

projects.name: OSU Micro-Benchmarks
projects.description: MPI point-to-point and collective communication benchmarks, including selected GPU-aware paths.
projects.comparability: Record MPI implementation, transport, process placement, message sizes and GPU-aware settings.

projects.name: Intel MPI Benchmarks
projects.description: MPI point-to-point, collective and one-sided communication benchmark suite.
projects.comparability: Pin MPI library, compiler, rank placement, network and message sizes.

projects.name: NVSHMEM
projects.description: GPU-centric communication library and performance examples for inter-GPU and cluster communication.
projects.comparability: NVIDIA ecosystem. Distinguish library microbenchmarks from end-to-end distributed training/inference.

projects.name: AI-Benchmark
projects.description: Android/mobile AI benchmark covering on-device neural-network workloads across supported devices.
projects.comparability: Record device, SoC, OS, runtime, thermal state and benchmark version.

projects.name: EEMBC MLMark
projects.description: Embedded machine-learning benchmark suite for evaluating constrained edge platforms.
projects.comparability: Check current suite availability, workload version, licensing and measurement rules.

projects.name: SPECpower_ssj2008
projects.description: Server-side Java workload used to evaluate server performance and power efficiency.
projects.comparability: Not an AI-specific benchmark. Useful only as broader server energy context; do not treat as accelerator AI performance.

projects.name: Green500
projects.description: Ranks supercomputers by measured energy efficiency on the LINPACK workload.
projects.comparability: LINPACK efficiency is not representative of LLM inference or all AI workloads; retain the workload context.

projects.name: DeepSparkInference
projects.description: Model adaptation, inference examples and published results across supported accelerator ecosystems.
projects.comparability: Classify results by original publisher and exact hardware/software configuration. Ecosystem examples are not neutral cross-vendor rankings.
